images.seen: A terrier wrapped in a wool blanket on a leather couch, steaming mug on the coffee table, frost-pale garden through the window. Thursday.
lines: One look at that white lawn and the blanket vote was unanimous.
Cold that reaches through a window gets met with wool and a full kettle.
The dog refused to go outside. Fair.

images.seen: A woman in a beanie and long puffer jacket on a park bench, sipping takeaway coffee with gloved hands, bare trees and a grey winter sky. Thursday.
lines: Coffee outside in this is a commitment, and she has made it.
Gloves-around-the-cup weather: the coffee is doing two jobs at once.
Your jacket has a jacket. It's that kind of day.

images.seen: A farm gate on a dirt road at sunset, thick mist filling the valley below, gum trees silhouetted against a purple-orange sky. Sunday.
lines: The mist has moved into the valley for the night and locked the gate behind it.
The valley pulled its blanket up early; the hills stay out a bit later.
That mist is tomorrow morning's frost out doing a site inspection.

images.seen: A mountain pass winding through snow-dusted slopes at dusk, one car with its headlights on, pink cloud over the ridgelines. Tuesday.
lines: Snow on the high ground, headlights on early: the pass has gone winter.
The sun is leaving the mountains one shelf at a time.
Berg air gets in through the vents no matter what the heater says.
